headline: Young Girl's Kindness Helps Injured Elderly Man Until Aid Arrives
meta_description: An 11-year-old schoolgirl stayed with an injured elderly man, ensuring his comfort while waiting for paramedics and using her pocket money to buy him food.
summary_short: When an 11-year-old schoolgirl found an injured elderly man, she didn't just call for help—she stayed by his side and bought him a meal with her own money.
body:
An 11-year-old schoolgirl demonstrated remarkable compassion when she discovered an injured elderly man and remained with him until paramedics arrived, prioritizing his safety and comfort.

Realizing the man hadn't eaten all day, the young girl took further action to help. Rather than simply waiting for emergency services, she used her own pocket money to purchase food for him, turning a crisis moment into an act of genuine care.

The incident, shared on Reddit's r/UpliftingNews community, highlights how young people can respond with empathy and practical kindness during emergencies. The girl's decision to stay present—offering both reassurance and nourishment—made a tangible difference in the elderly man's experience during a vulnerable time.
quick_facts: 11-year-old schoolgirl stayed with injured elderly man
Remained until paramedics arrived to help
Used her own pocket money to buy him food
Man had not eaten all day
